answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a paid voyage of work: the stake is locked in escrow and slashed if peers flag duplicate identities. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, one operator cannot cheaply clone thousands of agents, because each copy must lock fresh capital. Shale layers of reputation accumulate slowly, so a new identity cannot buy instant trust; an attacker must pay the deposit, wait out the aging period, and risk losing the stake on detection, making mass fakery unprofitable.
